column1: # The method's profiles (step7.md S7): each sets only the main session's
# model, effortLevel and availableModels in .claude/settings.json. The
# checking agents keep claude-opus-5-5 at xhigh in every profile, because
# each list holds claude-opus-5-5. scripts/method/lib/lock.pl reads and
# lints this file. A profile change takes effect from the next session.
# best: Best results, the default (the settings fragment as released).
# balanced: Anthropic's defaults (Opus 5.5 at medium effort); cheaper,
# budget: Sonnet 5.5 at medium effort; cheaper again, weaker on long or
#   subtle work. When a check misses something, step up a profile.
